$schema: Ported 1:1 from finstocks-app constants/motion.ts, which already mirrored the web keyframes 1:1 — this file makes that one source. Durations in ms; easings as cubic-bezier control points.

glow.$description: One-shot attention glow: decay ~2x the attack so the pull is quick and the release unhurried.

loop.$description: Continuous loops never settle, so they are tuned to read as ambient.

pressScale.$description: Compress is inversely proportional to the target: 3% reads as a firm tap on a 36px button, a 320px card caving in, invisible on a 24px glyph.
